review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Show billed tokens on failed usage rows**

When a streamed `response.incomplete` or `response.failed` includes usage, these nonzero values are saved on a row that still has `metadata["error"]`; `LlmUsage#failed?` therefore remains true, and the Settings LLM Usage table at `app/views/settings/llm_usages/show.html.erb:131-151` renders only “Failed” in the Tokens column instead of the newly recorded counts. Those tokens are nevertheless included in the summary totals and the row's cost is shown, so users cannot see or reconcile which failed call consumed the billed tokens; render the counts alongside the failure status.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
